EN.body:
Asah Dabar joins two Hebrew words. Asah means to do, to make, to carry out; dabar means word, both what God says and what that word brings about.
"Be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves." (James 1:22)
In the Hebrew New Testament, "doers of the word" is written with these two words, asah and dabar. Someone who meditates on the Word they have read, and then does the Word they have meditated on: that is the walk this app wants to help. It gathers the Bible text, plain explanations, reflection questions and prayers, linked verses and reading plans in one place to help you read and meditate on Scripture every day. Used with the PC app, what you organize on the PC continues on your phone.
EN.title: About Asah Dabar

KO.body:
아사 다바르는 히브리어 두 낱말을 이은 이름입니다. 「아사」는 행하다·만들다, 「다바르」는 말씀입니다.
「너희는 말씀을 행하는 자가 되고 듣기만 하여 자신을 속이는 자가 되지 말라」(약 1:22)
히브리어로 옮긴 신약은 이 「말씀을 행하는 자」를 아사와 다바르, 두 낱말로 적습니다. 읽은 말씀을 묵상하고, 묵상한 말씀을 행하는 사람. 이 앱은 그 걸음을 돕고 싶습니다. 성경 본문과 쉬운 설명, 묵상질문과 기도, 연결된 구절, 묵상플랜을 한자리에 모아 날마다 말씀을 읽고 묵상하도록 돕습니다. PC 앱과 함께 쓰면 PC 에서 정리한 것을 모바일 폰에서도 볼 수 있습니다.

· What we do not collect: the app does not collect your name, contact details, location, or IP address. Your notes, prayers, psalms, and AI chats stay on your phone and PC; we do not send them to our server.
· Sent only with your consent: anonymous usage statistics (totals such as how often a screen was opened; groups of fewer than five people are hidden) and a crash report the app asks about after it closed unexpectedly.

· What goes elsewhere: when you use AI, your question goes straight to the AI company you chose; when you tap a shopping link, you go to that store. From then on that company's privacy policy applies. The app has no ad tracking or cookies.
